objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed policy, guideline, procedural instruction, or work instruction that goes through creation, editing, release, versioning, and archiving lifecycle.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification level such as Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, or Work Instruction.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation prefix used in document naming (e.g. RL).

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Cross-client consecutive 4-digit number per document type.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Human-readable title of the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status (e.g. Editing, Released, Out of Force, Archived).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Current version number of the document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released version is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document remains valid.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Retention period after invalidation before physical deletion.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: Original file format (e.g. Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Original language of the document content.

attributes.name: client
attributes.description: Client(s) in which the document is visible in a multi-client system.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled sub-document linked to a main document that is versioned and released together with the main document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the attachment.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the attachment.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A non-controlled document supplement not subject to the release cycle of the main document.

attributes.name: published
attributes.description: Whether the additional info has been directly published via property switches.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal created by an author to suggest amendments to an existing released document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the change proposal (e.g. Created, Scheduled, Completed).

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A system-generated request to check and extend the validity of a document approaching its expiration date.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the request.

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to invalidate a released document and archive it, withdrawing it from circulation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the override request.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to re-validate a previously invalidated and archived document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the reactivation request.

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual person who participates in document processes in various roles.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the user.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A named group of users used for assigning authorizations and distribution.

attributes.name: group_name
attributes.description: Name of the user group (e.g. Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Archive).

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of user groups and persons assigned to a document for notification or acknowledgement upon release.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution: by e-mail or for acknowledgement.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A workflow instance managing the approval or processing steps for a document or request.

attributes.name: workflow_type
attributes.description: Type of workflow (e.g. Release, Validity Extension, Override, Reactivation, Translation Release, Acknowledgement).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the workflow.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A signature recorded by a workflow participant to confirm completion of a workflow step.

attributes.name: signer
attributes.description: Person who signed.

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: Workflow step in which the signature was given.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the signature was recorded.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document object is created in the system with selection of document type and optional template.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The type selected for the new document.

attributes.name: template
attributes.description: Template used for creating the document, if any.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the integrated editing client.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Metadata or attributes of a document are maintained or changed.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: The metadata category being edited (e.g. Master Data, Control).

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: The document is automatically converted to PDF after saving.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step approval workflow (Creator-Review-Release) is initiated for a document.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the Creator step of the release workflow.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document for technical and/or formal correctness.

attributes.name: review_type
attributes.description: Technical or formal review.

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: Positive completion or rejection.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser approves the document for publication.

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: Positive release or rejection.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the workflow, canceling subsequent tasks.

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: Workflow step at which rejection occurred (Review or Release).

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: The document is automatically published and made visible to addressed readers after release.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created for revision.

attributes.name: trigger
attributes.description: Reason for new version (content change, attribute change, attachment change, change proposal).

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: A new controlled attachment is added to a document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: edit_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is modified, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived with the next release of the main document.

evts.name: create_additional_info
evts.description: An additional info object is added to a document without affecting the main document version.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: An additional info object is removed from a document.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is created for an existing released document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, triggering a new document version.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is marked as completed and removed from display in the document.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: The system generates a validity extension request 30 days before the document's valid-until date.

evts.name: process_validity_extension
evts.description: The validity extension workflow is processed, resulting in extended validity or revision/override.

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: Validity extended, revision initiated, or override requested.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The document's validity is confirmed and the valid-until date is updated by the default period.

attributes.name: new_valid_until
attributes.description: Updated valid-until date.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: A request to invalidate and archive a document is created.

evts.name: process_override
evts.description: The override workflow steps are carried out (Creator check, review, release).

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: Override confirmed or rejected.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: The document is declared out of force, revoking all rights except the archive group.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: A request to reactivate an archived document is created by the Business Admin group.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: The reactivation workflow is confirmed, creating a new version of the archived document.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or write authorizations are assigned to user groups or persons for a document.

attributes.name: authorization_type
attributes.description: Read or write.

evts.name: assign_workflow_participant
evts.description: A user is assigned to a role (author, co-author, reviewer, releaser) in the document's release control.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: The role assigned (Author, Co-Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator).

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: User groups or persons are added to or removed from a document's distribution list.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: By e-mail or for acknowledgement.

evts.name: send_email_notification
evts.description: An email notification is sent to users about workflow tasks, releases, or status changes.

attributes.name: notification_type
attributes.description: Type of notification (workflow task, release info, validity extension info, override info, acknowledgement request).

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Users on the acknowledgement distribution list are requested to confirm they have read the document.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A user confirms acknowledgement of a released document version.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content is translated into another language.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: The language the document is translated into.

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: A translated version is reviewed for correctness.

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: Positive or rejection.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: A translated version is approved and released, making it visible to readers in the corresponding language.

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: Positive release or rejection.

evts.name: physical_delete_document
evts.description: A document is physically deleted after the archive period has expired.

o2o.description: An Attachment belongs to and is controlled by a main Document.
Additional Info is supplementary to a Document without affecting its versioning.
A Change Proposal is linked to a specific Document it proposes to amend.
A Validity Extension Request is linked to the Document whose validity is being checked.
An Override Request is linked to the Document to be invalidated.
A Reactivation Request references the archived Document to be reactivated.
A Distribution List is maintained for a specific Document.
A Distribution List contains User Groups to be notified.
A Distribution List can contain individual Users.
A User belongs to one or more User Groups.
An Electronic Signature is recorded within a Workflow step.
A Workflow manages the approval process for a Document.
A Document can reference another Document (e.g. local extension referencing original).
